title: Convert Table to Shapes (Tables)

scenarios.title: Convert Table to Shapes applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Convert Table to Shapes (BtnConvertTableToShapes) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnConvertTableToShapes deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the non-interactive conversion of the fixture 3x3 table (ReplaceOriginal, no prompts) deletes the original table and leaves exactly one grouped shape whose nine rectangles carry the original cell texts r1c1..r3c3 at the table's original 300x150 pt bounds at 40/40, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the non-interactive conversion of the fixture 3x3 table (ReplaceOriginal, no prompts) deletes the original table and leaves exactly one grouped shape whose nine rectangles carry the original cell texts r1c1..r3c3 at the table's original 300x150 pt bounds at 40/40, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
